description: feature:wallet — implement WalletScreen (F-05) with WalletViewModel (@HiltViewModel + StateFlow). F-05 per wireframe lines ~526-573: TealGradientHeader with KSh balance + M-Pesa linked, Withdraw + Statement buttons, month toggle (This/Last/All time), transaction list with +green/-red amount colour coding. NO navigation change required (WALLET route already calls WalletScreen()). INDEPENDENT of all other FEATs.
steps: Read /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/NANGA_WIREFRAMES.html lines 526-573 for F-05 markup. Read core/ui TealGradientHeader.kt and theme/Color.kt tokens (GreenDeep for +amounts, ErrorRed for -amounts, Slate for timestamps, White/TealDark/TealMid for header).

Create feature/wallet/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/wallet/WalletUiState.kt: enum TxnType { INCOME, EXPENSE }; data class Transaction(id, title, subtitle/date, amountKsh:Int, type:TxnType); data class WalletUiState(balanceKsh:Int, mpesaLinked:Boolean, mpesaNumber:String, month:WalletMonth, transactions:List<Transaction>, isLoading:Boolean); enum WalletMonth { THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, ALL_TIME }.

Create feature/wallet/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/wallet/WalletViewModel.kt: @HiltViewModel class WalletViewModel : ViewModel() exposing StateFlow<WalletUiState> seeded in init with sample data matching wireframe (balance KSh 18,450; M-Pesa linked +254 7XX; transactions: Catch Sale Tuna 12kg +KSh4,200 INCOME, M-Pesa Withdrawal -KSh5,000 EXPENSE, Mangrove bonus +KSh800 INCOME). Provide setMonth(WalletMonth) that filters/adjusts the transaction list.

Replace feature/wallet/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/wallet/WalletScreen.kt: @Composable fun WalletScreen(viewModel: WalletViewModel = hiltViewModel()). Layout: Column — TealGradientHeader(title="Wallet") with a custom content row below the title showing balance 'KSh 18,450' (28sp bold White) + 'Available balance' caption, and right-aligned 'M-Pesa linked' + masked number (use a Box overlay or a second header area; if TealGradientHeader's actions slot is insufficient, place the balance block as a custom gradient Box matching the hero-bar style but using only TealDark/TealMid tokens); Withdraw (primary, up-arrow) + Statement (secondary, clipboard) buttons in a Row; month toggle Row of 3 FilterChip-like toggles (selected = GreenMid bg / White text); 'Transactions' section label; transaction rows (avatar emoji, title bold, date in Slate, amount INCOME -> GreenDeep '+KSh N' / EXPENSE -> ErrorRed '-KSh N'). Use MaterialTheme.typography + NangaTheme tokens; RoundedCornerShape 8-12dp. Observe uiState via collectAsStateWithLifecycle().

Run: cd /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/.worktrees/phase4b-screens/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug — expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Commit on branch phase4b-screens via git -C /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/.worktrees/phase4b-screens. Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: WalletScreen renders a gradient header with balance and M-Pesa linked indicator, Withdraw + Statement buttons, a 3-option month toggle, and a transaction list
Income transaction amounts render in GreenDeep with a + prefix; expense amounts render in ErrorRed with a - prefix
No hardcoded Color(0x..) hex in feature/wallet; only NangaTheme tokens + MaterialTheme.colorScheme
